title: In-Vivo Glucose-Stimulated Insulin Secretion Test
author: Fawaz G. Haj
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yptfvnn

steps.title: Fast the mice
steps.instruction: Fast mice for 16 hours by removing food at 3:00pm the day before the experiment.

steps.title: Calibrate glucose meter
steps.instruction: Calibrate the glucose meter according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Collect baseline blood sample
steps.instruction: Deprive mice of water and collect a baseline blood sample.

substeps.instruction: Measure blood glucose level using a glucometer.
Remove approximately 50 μl of blood from the tail via a tail tip cut.
Transfer blood directly into a sterile 0.5ml microcentrifuge tube containing 2ul Heparin.

steps.title: Process and store plasma
steps.instruction: Isolate plasma from the blood sample and freeze.

substeps.instruction: Transfer plasma (supernatant) to a new 0.5ml microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Administer glucose injection
steps.instruction: Give the mouse an intraperitoneal injection of Glucose (2g/kg) using a 27 G needle.

steps.title: Collect post-injection blood samples
steps.instruction: Collect blood samples from the initial tail cut at specific time intervals following the injection.

substeps.instruction: Take samples at 2, 5, 15, and 30 min post-injection.
For each sample, repeat the blood collection and plasma processing steps (as described in steps 3 and 4).

steps.title: Post-procedure animal care
steps.instruction: Ensure the animal is stable before returning to the cage.

substeps.instruction: Wipe the tail with 70% alcohol and allow to dry.
Verify that blood loss from the tail has stopped before placing the animal back in its cage.
